resources.description: Documentation for AI agents and developers: agent surfaces, authentication, and example requests.
Machine-readable overview of the site: what it is, coverage, and key pages.
How agents obtain credentials: none needed for public read-only content; website sign-up for listing owners.
Listing tiers in plain markdown: Basic PKR 99, Premium PKR 199, Featured PKR 299, one-time.
Markdown twin of the homepage: what the site is, coverage, and how to find or list a business.
XML sitemap of the site's indexable public pages.
OpenAPI 3.1 document for the free read-only public API: search businesses, get one business, list categories and cities. Max 20 results per page, 60 requests per minute per IP, no key needed.
Model Context Protocol server over Streamable HTTP at /api/mcp: tools search_businesses, get_business, list_categories, list_cities. Read-only, no authentication.
Server card for the LocalePak MCP server: display name, logo, description, endpoint, and tool list.
RFC 8414 metadata stating the honest position: LocalePak is not a full OAuth server — no authorization or token endpoint, no client registration; owners sign in with email/password on the website.
RFC 9728 metadata for the public API resource, naming the real scopes listings:read (public) and listings:write (website session only).
